arguments.name: 1 Lists
arguments.notes: Main view. Sidebar: search, Lists/Board, lists grouped by category, a status pill only when a link needs attention. Hovering a row shows the drag handle and the open-details arrow.

arguments.name: 2 Item details
arguments.notes: Details open on demand (click the arrow or press Space). Shows links and notes. Category, board column, due date and backlinks sit under More details.

arguments.name: 3 Drag in & right-click
arguments.notes: Drag a file from the file manager onto an item: only a link is saved. Dropping between rows makes a new item. Right-click a link: Open, Show in folder (file pre-selected), Copy path; More… holds Re-link and Open with.

arguments.name: 4 Board
arguments.notes: Cards are lists. Column menu appears on hover; Delete is disabled while a column holds cards. Board ⋯ holds rarely used options (show sub-lists as cards, lists not on the board).

arguments.name: 5 Moved & missing
arguments.notes: Only reached from the sidebar pill when something needs attention. Moves are followed automatically; this page lists what couldn't be.

arguments.name: 6 Settings
arguments.notes: Everyday settings only. Advanced is collapsed.

arguments.name: 7 Settings – advanced
arguments.notes: Advanced expanded: watched folders, missing-file behaviour, file format, devices.

arguments.name: 8 Phone – list
arguments.notes: Links to files that only exist on a PC are dimmed.

arguments.name: 9 Phone – file on another PC
arguments.notes: Tapping a PC-only file. Get a copy fetches it peer-to-peer; the rarer options are under More options.

arguments.name: 10 Phone – board
arguments.notes: One column at a time; tabs switch columns.

arguments.name: 11 Phone – share in
arguments.notes: The phone equivalent of drag-and-drop: Share › Organise.
